_about: Station knowledge the GTFS does not carry. Read by scripts/build_gtfs_data.py; stops are matched by stop_code. Minutes are estimates to be checked on site (planning/CHECKLIST.md).

underground.note: Red Line stations in the tunnel: time between the street and the platform, added to every walk to or from the station (decided 16.10.2026).

transfers.note: Red Line Arlozorov to Israel Railways Tel Aviv Savidor: 5 minutes up from the tunnel, about 5 minutes on the street (290 m), 2 minutes through the station entrance and security. Replaces the generic walk.
